statement.p:
The rectangles in the graph above illustrate a right endpoint Riemann sum for f(x) on the interval 4 \leq x \leq 6. The value of this right endpoint Riemann sum is , and this Riemann sum is
[select an answer]

solution.p: (A) The left endpoint Riemann sum is f(4) \cdot 0.5 + f(4.5) \cdot 0.5 + \cdots + f(5.5) \cdot 0.5 = ( 4 + 3.55555555555556 + \cdots + 2.90909090909091 ) \cdot 0.5 = 6.83232.
(B) The right endpoint Riemann sum is f(4.5) \cdot 0.5 + f(5) \cdot 0.5 + \cdots + f(6) \cdot 0.5 = ( 3.55555555555556 + 3.2 + \cdots + 2.66666666666667 ) \cdot 0.5 = 6.16566.
